findings.description: F-003: the paired notebook 18-06's Scale 'working example' printed 'Толщина: 3' instead of 7 because the Scale is never .pack()ed, so Tk never invokes the -command. The lesson's central claim about Scale's command was silently contradicted by its own practice. Verified: unpacked set(7) -> command calls []; packed -> ['7'].
findings.resolution: Fixed in notebooks/chapter-18/18-06-razmer-cveta.ipynb: added scale.pack() before scale.set(7) with an inline comment explaining that Tk does not invoke -command for an unmapped widget, plus a new 'Проверка результата' cell asserting tolschina == 7. Re-executed with xvfb-run: output changed from 'Толщина: 3' to 'Толщина: 7'.
